spans.s: --a son of Vanhi, and father of Kapotaroman. (ब्र्। and वि। प्। make him a son of Kapotaroman). भा. IX. २४. १९-20; Br. III. ७१. ११७; Vi. IV. १४. १३.
(III)--the second son of खशा (s.v.) with three heads, three feet, three hands, black eyes, etc. वा. ६९. ७६, ८०-3.
(IV)--a hell, to which go the thieves and those who transgress established rules. Vi.
